name: Archetype 02 — Airtable Record on Stripe Checkout Completed

_archetype_metadata.description: Triggered by Stripe checkout.session.completed webhook; verifies the signature, normalizes the customer payload, writes a record to Airtable, and acknowledges. The starter archetype for any commerce → CRM/spreadsheet sync flow. Customize the Airtable base+table via SET_DEFAULTS.
operator_action_required: Replace <STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET> with the customer's whsec_* (from Stripe dashboard)
Replace <AIRTABLE_API_KEY> with customer's Airtable PAT (scoped to one base)
Map Stripe customer fields to Airtable columns in the MAP_FIELDS node
_archetype_metadata.sovereign_tier_addon: For sovereign tier ($1,497), replace Airtable with operator's hosted PostgreSQL via the postgres node; the rest of the flow stays identical
